published_source: 'Designing a stem-loop RT-qPCR method for measuring miRNA-16 expression in human plasma samples' — Table 1 'Sequence and characteristics of the stem-loop RT-qPCR primers set'. Uses the same Chen-2005 universal stem-loop body and universal reverse as this tool; the tool's RT primer and reverse are byte-identical to this published set.

Yang L-h, et al. Universal Stem-Loop Primer Method. PLoS ONE 2014;9(12):e115293. DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0115293 — miR-150 forward qPCR primer (5' GC tail added to raise Tm). NOTE: Yang 2014 uses a different stem-loop body and reverse (random 3' end), so only the forward miRNA-specific core is comparable; no RT exact-match applies.

Czimmerer Z, et al. A Versatile Method to Design Stem-Loop Primer-Based Quantitative PCR Assays. PLoS ONE 2013;8(1):e55168. DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0055168, Table 2 (mmu-mir-1; sequence identical to hsa-miR-1-3p). NOTE: different universal body (GTTGGCTCTGG...CCAGAGCCAAC) and reverse (GTGCAGGGTCCGAGGT), so no full-RT exact-match applies — only the 6-nt overhang and the forward miRNA-specific core are comparable.
Czimmerer Z, et al. PLoS ONE 2013;8(1):e55168. DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0055168, Table 2 (hsa-mir-181a). Different universal body/reverse — overhang + forward-core comparison only.

Ngo Thi Mai Vy (student ID 20187223). 'Development of the Quantification Procedure for miR-125b-5p in Human Plasma Samples Using Stemloop RT-qPCR.' Bachelor's thesis (lab internal, unpublished). Same Chen-2005 universal stem-loop body; universal reverse GCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTC (18 nt, a different loop window than this tool's fixed 20-nt reverse, so reverse is not exact-matched). RT overhang TCACAA = revcomp of 3'-terminal UUGUGA (independently verified).

Zhao F-L, Dou Y-C, Wang X-F, Han D-C, Lv Z-G, Ge S-L, Zhang Y-K. 'Serum microRNA-195 is down-regulated in breast cancer: a potential marker for the diagnosis of breast cancer.' Mol Biol Rep. 2014;41(9):5913-5922. DOI 10.1007/s11033-014-3466-1, Table 2 ('The sequences of miR-16 and miR-195 stem-loop RT and PCR primers'). Same Chen-2005 universal stem-loop body (GTCGTATCCAGTGCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTCGCACTGGATACGAC) and universal reverse GCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTC. NOTE: the published RT hybridizes 7 nt (GCCAATA = revcomp of 3'-terminal UAUUGGC); this tool's fixed 6-nt overhang (GCCAAT) is the 6-nt prefix of it — a deliberate design choice within Chen's 6-8 nt binding range, not a mismatch. Forward-specific core comparison only.

Truong Gia Hung. 'Xay dung quy trinh dinh luong miR-9-3p trong huyet tuong bang phuong phap stemloop RT-qPCR' (Building a quantification procedure for miR-9-3p in plasma by stem-loop RT-qPCR). Bachelor's thesis (lab internal, unpublished), 'Bang 3.2'. Universal reverse GCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTC. Forward-specific core comparison only (stem-loop 3' overhang in the source table was not machine-legible).

Le Tran Bao Bao. 'Xay dung quy trinh dinh luong miR-222-3p trong huyet tuong bang phuong phap stemloop RT-qPCR' (Building a quantification procedure for miR-222-3p in plasma by stem-loop RT-qPCR). Bachelor's thesis (lab internal, unpublished). Same Chen-2005 universal stem-loop body; universal reverse GCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTC (18-nt loop window, not exact-matched vs this tool's 20-nt reverse). RT overhang ACCCAG = revcomp of 3'-terminal CUGGGU (independently verified). Published amplicon 56 bp.

Tran Thuy Linh. 'Xay dung quy trinh dinh luong miR-221-3p trong huyet tuong bang phuong phap stemloop RT-qPCR' (Building a quantification procedure for miR-221-3p in plasma by stem-loop RT-qPCR). Bachelor's thesis (lab internal, unpublished). Same Chen-2005 universal stem-loop body; universal reverse GCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTC (18-nt loop window, not exact-matched vs this tool's 20-nt reverse). RT overhang GAAACC = revcomp of 3'-terminal GGUUUC (independently verified).
